gcp.description: Whether to generate a Docker startup test that pulls from the GCP registry.

gitlab.description: Whether to generate a Docker startup test that pulls from the GitLab registry.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite existing configuration files during generation.

skipFormat.description: Whether to skip formatting files with Prettier after generation.

components.x-prompt: Should gitlab ci/cd components be used
components.description: Whether to use GitLab CI/CD components in the generated configuration.

tags.description: The list of project tags to filter for Docker configuration.

skipStartup.description: Whether to skip generating the Docker startup test.

skipE2eService.description: Whether to skip generating the E2E service configuration.

project.description: The name of the project to initialize GitLab CI Docker configuration for.
